source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the third line of defence (PDF 175).

blocks.text: Kabhi jaraseem pehli aur doosri lines tor dete hain; phir unhein teesri line ka saamna hota hai jo immune system deta hai. Yeh makhsoos difa hai: yeh khaas jaraseem ko nishana bana kar un ke khilaf kaam karta hai. Yeh pichhle hamla awaron ko yaad bhi rakhta aur dobara aane par tezi se jawab deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si do khasiyatein teesri line ko pehli do se mukhtalif banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh makhsoos hai, khaas jaraseem ko nishana banati, aur is mein yaad hai, doosri mulaqat par tez jawab deti hai.

items: Teesri line = immune system: makhsoos, yaad ke saath.
